segments.text: Gumgumi is just standing there, like always.
But right now, it's spinning at incredible speed.
And somehow, none of it feels real.
The balance organ in your ear only notices sudden changes in speed.
But Earth's spin never changes - it's always steady.
So there's no change for your body to catch.
A plane flying at a steady speed feels like it's standing still.
But sudden turbulence? You feel that instantly.
Earth's spin never changes either, so it's the same story.
That's why you can't feel this fast spin at all.
